modeling_decisions: Panel C hero/top agree on open crescent; side sketch exaggerates isolated peak, reject that inconsistency. Wind from +Y toward -Y, horns extend -Y. Use single continuous swept crescent volume: windward +Y outer toe, long gentle stoss rise to curved crest, short steep concave -Y slipface. Height falls continuously toward unequal horn tips. No separate base/platform, closed floor underside, no crater. Nominal8x6x1.6m broad module, measured bounds separate.
